newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom begins Internet phone trial.
newsitem.headline: Telecom begins Internet phone trial.

text.p: Communications Minister Maurice Williamson on Friday launched Telecom Corp of New Zealand's phone trial over the Internet.
Williamson placed a call to Australia using standard phones linked by the Internet and technology from Xtra's partner, Israel-based VocalTec Ltd.
Telecom's trial involves 400 customers with the ability to call internationally at prices from 49 cents to $1.85 per minute.
Using the VocalTec software one PC user can call another via the Internet equipped with sound. PC to phone calls can be made using 'dialler' software via a "Telephony Gateway".
Phone-to-phone calls work in similar fashion via an 0800 number.
Telecom said the trial is due to run for several months with the aim of becoming a fully fledged commercial service around the middle of this year.
